name: manual_590ae6
claim: Before moving a shared remote branch ref, prove every intended tree entry by comparing the remote-created blob SHA with the locally verified Git blob SHA, then use an expected-head compare-and-set update; a failed local reconstruction must leave the ref unchanged.

decisions.notes: ChatGPT Work/Codex GitHub update, 2026-10-14: a byte-level mismatch in reconstructed semantic memory was detected before the ref move because the candidate blob SHA did not equal git hash-object. The failed attempt created only unreachable objects; the PR branch stayed at its previous head.
